api.begin: begin(fields,mode) -> stable snapshot; captures descriptor values, performs no reads or normalization; sets pending/targetMode/completed/total while leaving completed published values unchanged.
api.step: step(limit=4) -> snapshot,done,processed[,error]; at most min(limit,64) input descriptors/native reads/normalizations per call; invalid limit performs zero work. Final step copies completed values atomically into the same published records/order.
api.cancel: cancel() -> snapshot; stops pending work without clearing published completed values.
api.resetBindings: Cancels pending and clears receipt/values in stable published record identities.

memory: At most64published records and64private work records. Work slots, seen-key map, published records and order are reused across cycles; removed published bindings are pruned. No SD/transport/output/timer calls.
coverage: Cancel and reset midcycle with zero future reads
Invert-extrema exact IDs and physical/native provenance
limits: Final publication copies at most64 records in one callback; caller must use normal bounded scheduling and obtain actual native budget evidence.
Published CURRENT/currentness flags describe each field at its most recent bounded acquisition; snapshot pending explicitly exposes a cycle in progress.
Do not render completed MIN values as MAX: compare snapshot.mode with requested display mode; targetMode is pending intent only.
Synchronous sample remains available for standalone callers and legacy tests; retained main must call incremental APIs.
